title: Whitening norm for equal-sign coordinates
statement: Let $\rho\in(-1,1)$ and let $s\in\{\pm1\}$. For every $c\in\mathbb R$, the Euclidean norm of the inverse square-root whitening of $(sc,sc)$ by the matrix with diagonal entries $1$ and off-diagonal entries $\rho$ is at most $\sqrt{2}\,|c|/\sqrt{1+\rho}$.
